data.source: Dukascopy JForex via pinned dukascopy-go v0.2.0

gate_reasons: No market-timeframe cell has a positive full-period bootstrap 95% confidence interval excluding zero.
M15 and H1 weighted effects are negative.
The three H4 cells positive in all splits have only 1 to 10 OOS signals.
The aggregate Development effect is negative and the OOS sign change is not stable across cells.
The provisional common-edge minimum of 200 unique OOS episodes and 70% positive markets is not met.
Energy markets were not acquired, so cross-asset common-edge recognition is not estimable.
method_limitations: This is a bar-data screening run, not the final OANDA MT5 broker validation.
Signal midpoint OHLC was approximated from separate BID and ASK bars; synchronized tick-derived MID was not available.

Controls were matched by instrument, timeframe, year, UTC four-hour block, prior-only ATR/trend/spread deciles, and a plus/minus 60-day window; the temporary runner did not explicitly enforce the frozen split label during matching.
Bootstrap resampled signal edges independently and did not apply synchronized global-block clustering or familywise multiple-testing correction.
Therefore this run can reject promotion of this implementation but cannot establish that every valid implementation of the hypothesis has zero edge.
next_action: Archive PA-002 as a rejected preliminary implementation. Return to blind discovery for new price, volume-volatility, and regime hypotheses; only qualifying candidates receive canonical OANDA MT5 tick/BID/ASK validation.
